comments.text:
To make the Current Episode pane area make more sense when we're _not_ hovering over it, please introduce a highlighting vertical line to its left, that can be aligned with the descriptive text below it. 

On hover, I want the "Choose a different episode" text to be more dynamically rendered than it is now. Maybe like some sort of ticker micointeraction? To make this more seamless, you can change the treatment of the choose a different epiosde action item to be all caps and gold (and ditch the library books). I still do want the leftward arrow, though!.

comments.label: COSMOS 2543+USA 245
comments.text: When we scroll down and see this header, I still want a way to toggle between Cosmos 2542 and 2543 (in this case; in other cases there's no toggling; in other cases the toggling happens on the target satellite side).

comments.label: 3D globe
comments.text: There's something going wrong with how the reference orbit is being rendered. The idea of the reference orbit is that it's always in view and fixed in the reference frame we've chosen. That's not the case now. Please be careful to ensure that hte portion of the reference orbit that is in front of the Earth is visible and that the portion behind the Earth is not.

comments.label: 3D globe
comments.text: The label that says "Reference orbit" is off-kilter from the reference orbit at the spot it's in right now. Get smarter to make sure it's angularly aligned.

comments.label: 3D globe
comments.text: While watching the animation play, there are times in which the USA 245 satellite dot and trail go missing. They should always be in view (since we're being careful to select a camera angle where that's physically the case).

comments.label: 3D globe
comments.text: Right now, the satellite dot labels are dynamically changing their position relative to the satellite they refer to via violent hops. Make that more smooth, so the reader can clearly track which satellite is which.

comments.label: Velocity chart
comments.text: I think the default relative velocity should be different for this scneario. Can you try 500 m/s? Actually, this whole pane should be in km/s, when that's a more meaningful unit.
